mapper.select:
SELECT p.*, o.name AS owner_name FROM parking p LEFT JOIN owner o ON p.owner_id = o.id
AND p.spot_number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{spotNumber}, '%')
AND p.status = #{status}
ORDER BY p.id DESC
